# Rig

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/rig_pose.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/rig_pose.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

The rig of a world: the kinematic tree of the body file (RigModel), next to RigPose.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | `std::shared_ptr<RigModel>` | forward kinematics, joint frames and conversions, IK limits (limits, enlargeable) and body file limits, segment masses |

## Notes

Created by ensureRig from HumanBot::body on the first call of any gait or IK system. The RigModel is shared and mutable: GaitFootIK widens the ankles' IK limits in it.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Fabrik, GaitBalance, GaitBase, GaitChecks, GaitHandIK, RigPoseApply. Written by: GaitFootIK, GaitRoutes. Created by: Fabrik, GaitBalance, GaitBase, GaitChecks, GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK, GaitRoutes. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Fabrik](../systems/Fabrik.md) | system | World | **read+create** | tick, ensureRig | the rig model of the chain's rig; created by ensureRig on first use |
| [GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md) | system | World | **read+create** | tick, ensureRig | the model: solves, forward kinematics, centre of mass |
| [GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md) | system | World | **read+create** | tick, ensureRig | the rig model: geometry, forward kinematics, limits |
| [GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md) | system | World | **read+create** | tick, ensureRig | geometry, joint frames, IK and body file limits |
| [GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick, ensureRig | the model for trial solves; the ankles' IK limits widened on the first tick (shared RigModel) |
| [GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md) | system | World | **read+create** | tick, ensureRig | the model: arm geometry, trial solves, limits |
| [GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md) | system | World | **write+create** | ensureRig | created with the bot's body on the first call |
| [RigPoseApply](../systems/RigPoseApply.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | the rig model for forward kinematics |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Fabrik](../systems/Fabrik.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities on the first tick of a gait.
- **[GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities the first time scrambling is on.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[RigPoseApply](../systems/RigPoseApply.md)**
  - Moves or teleports every kinematic Jolt body of the bot each tick.
  - Logs an error once per process when the bot is not kinematic.
